description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

UnitedHealth Group is hiring an Associate Full Stack Software Engineer to modernize platform architectures and build scalable microservices, API-driven workflows, and cloud-native solutions. The role also develops ETL pipelines and AI-powered features, automates development processes, and collaborates with Agile teams on resilient technology solutions.
Associate Full Stack Software Engineer building microservices, Actian Data Connect pipelines, AI features, and cloud-native applications with CI/CD.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain microservices and high-performance API-driven applications using Python, Java, Node.js, Typescripts or React
• Design, build, and optimize enterprise ETL data pipelines using Actian Data Connect or comparable integration tools to ensure seamless data flow
• Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered features, integrations, and automation solutions with an emphasis on responsible technology use
• Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools and modern automation patterns to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and drive continuous platform improvement
• Evaluate emerging technical trends and AI-driven solutions to inform platform modernization, architectural design, and strategic innovation
• Architect and deploy scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-native applications on AZURE / Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Establish and optimize automated CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks to support high code quality and operational resilience
• Collaborate in a dynamic Agile/Scrum team environment across all phases of the SDLC, including production support and troubleshooting

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a CS or IT or engineering related field
• 1+ years of overall software engineering experience working across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from design to production support
• 1+ years of experience developing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based microservices and API-driven architectures using Python or Java
• 1 year of experience with front end technologies like Node.js, Typescripts or React
• 1 years of experience designing and managing ETL pipelines utilizing Actian Data Connect or enterprise integration tools
• 1 years of experience working with AZURE or AWS cloud platforms (e.g., Lambda, S3, EC2, ECS, or RDS)
• 1 year of experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and functional testing)
• 1 year of experience working in an Agile/Scrum development framework
• 6+ months of demonstrated experience integrating or building application features that leverage AI technologies (e.g., AI/ML APIs, cognitive search, LLM integrations, or smart automations)
• Ability to participate in on-call rotations and provide production support under dynamic, fast-paced conditions

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E / B.Tech), MCA, or equivalent technical field
• Experience with AWS containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes
• Experience with modern database technologies (SQL, NoSQL)
• Proven analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a history of resolving critical system issues under tight deadlines
• Strong passion for continuous learning and adapting to new technical environments, automation tools, and frameworks
